ROW.COLUMN: (FR/EE) Employee Withdrawal of Funds by ATM/On-line Banking

Bank/Debit cards and internet banking can be easily utilized to transfer assets to other individuals or institutions due to the anonymity afforded the customer. This scenario detects employees who withdraw funds from an account to which they have access using possibly compromised or fraudulent credentials. The employee has previously collected funds in the account from other customers' accounts.
This scenario detects potentially fraudulent withdrawals through either ATM or on-line channels where the firm will suffer the loss of customer assets. In the case of withdrawals through an ATM, the account is owned by or related to the employee. For withdrawals through on-line banking, the account is not owned by or related to the employee, but the employee has control over the account in a way which may be unknown to the firm.

GROUP BY a.Emp_Intrl_Id, a.Emp_Seq_Id, a.Acct_Intrl_Id, a.Emp_Type, a.Net_Wrth_Am HAVING --Total Amount of ATM Debits of Target Account >= Min Total Debit Amount --OR --Total Amount of ATM Debits to the Target Account >= Min Net Worth x Min Net Worth Percentage/100 ( (a.Emp_Type = 'NEW' and (sum(a.Trxn_Base_Am) >= @Min_Total_Debit_Amt_New or sum(a.Trxn_Base_Am) >= a.Net_Wrth_Am* @Min_Net_Worth_Prctg_New / 100 )) OR (a.Emp_Type = 'SEASONED' and (sum(a.Trxn_Base_Am) >= @Min_Total_Debit_Amt_Seasoned or sum(a.Trxn_Base_Am) >= a.Net_Wrth_Am* @Min_Net_Worth_Prctg_Seasoned / 100 )) ) )

UNION ALL SELECT T.EMP_INTRL_ID, T.EMP_SEQ_ID, T.Emp_Type, T.Acct_Intrl_Id, T.Net_Wrth_Am, T.Tot_Dbt_Trxn_Ct, T.Tot_Dbt_Trxn_Am, T.Net_Wrth_Prctg, T.Dbt_Lrf_Trxn_Am, T.Last_Trxn_Dt, M.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, M.TRXN_BASE_AM, (CASE WHEN M.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(M.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN M.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN M.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(M.CLR_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN M.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN M.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(M.DEP_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN M.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN M.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(M.ISSUE_TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN M.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END) Lrf_Trxn_Am, CASE WHEN M.TRSTD_TRXN_FL = 'Y' THEN M.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS Trusted_Trans_Amt

UNION ALL SELECT T.EMP_INTRL_ID, T.EMP_SEQ_ID, T.Emp_Type, T.Acct_Intrl_Id, T.Net_Wrth_Am, T.Tot_Dbt_Trxn_Ct, T.Tot_Dbt_Trxn_Am, T.Net_Wrth_Prctg, T.Dbt_Lrf_Trxn_Am, T.Last_Trxn_Dt, M.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, M.TRXN_BASE_AM, (CASE WHEN M.TRXN_BASE_AM - SELECT E.EMP_INTRL_ID, E.EMP_SEQ_ID, C.DATA_DUMP_DT, C.TRXN_EXCTN_DT, C.TRXN_EXCTN_TM, C.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, C.ACCT_INTRL_ID, CASE C.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD WHEN 'ATM' THEN C.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_DTL_2_TX WHEN 'DEBIT-TERMINAL' THEN C.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_DTL_1_TX END AS Branch_Id, C.TRXN_BASE_AM, CASE WHEN c.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(c.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN c.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN c.TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(c.TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN c.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END AS Lrf_Trxn_Am, CASE WHEN E.EMP_HIRE_DT is not null AND ((SELECT KC.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC WHERE KC.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL' AND KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) - E.EMP_HIRE_DT) < @Min_Employment_Length THEN 'NEW' ELSE 'SEASONED' END AS Emp_Type, (select abps.NET_WRTH_AM from @BUSINESS@.ACCT_BAL_POSN_SMRY abps where A.ACCT_INTRL_ID = abps.ACCT_INTRL_ID and abps.DATA_DUMP_DT = (select kl.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kl where kl.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and kl.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') ) as Net_Wrth_Am
